name: Arnold Classic Africa 2019

venue.name: Sandton Convention Centre
venue.address: 161 Maude St, Sandown, Sandton, 2031, South Africa
venue.details: On Level 2 of the Convention Centre

information: ### General Information This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. ### Guests Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through WebTickets or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day. [Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1488067599) ### Volunteering If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact one of the WCA delegates. Please state which dates and times you will be available. Volunteer schedules will be drawn up so that they don't clash with your competing.
